evidence.quote: we compare here gas kinematics traced by ionized and neutral molecular lines and discuss the implication on ambipolar diffusion.

analysis_steps.goal: Make moment maps, spectra and PV diagrams

method.value: Moment 0/1 maps, spectra at protostar after convolution to 0.5" beam, PV cuts along major (PA 16 deg) and minor axes

evidence.quote: Figure 4 presents the position–velocity (PV) diagrams along the major and minor axes of the flattened envelope passing through the protostellar position.

analysis_steps.goal: Fit kinematical model of infalling flattened envelope to PV diagrams

method.value: 3D power-law density/temperature envelope, free-fall velocity, LTE model images, simulated ALMA observations, chi2 fit to PV diagrams of C18O and H13CO+

evidence.quote: Then we simulated ALMA observations of the model images with the same array configuration and coverage of hour angle as our real observations.

key_parameters.value: Free parameters n(R0), p, Vin(R0); j fixed at 3e-5 km/s pc or 0; low-velocity channels 7.7–8.9 km/s excluded; R0=100 au; outer radius 700 au

evidence.quote: The channels at the low velocities of $V_{\rm LSR} = 7.7\mbox{--}8.9$ km s$^{-1}$ (vertical dashed lines in Fig. 5) are excluded in the fitting

assumptions.value: Distance 100 pc, inclination 87 deg, T=38 K (r/100au)^-0.4, polar cavity within 60 deg of axis empty

fitting.value: chi2 minimization; uncertainties from models with chi2 < chi2min + 1

evidence.quote: The uncertainties of our best-fit parameters are estimated from the parameter ranges of the models having $\chi^2$ less than the minimum $\chi^2$ + 1

validation.value: Tested PA changes of ±10 deg and shallower velocity profile r^-0.25; results unchanged within 0.1 km/s

evidence.quote: The difference between the best-fit $V_{\rm in}$(100 au) with the two different velocities profiles is 0.1 km s$^{-1}$, less than our uncertainty.

findings_qualitative.value: Central compact 1–2" component elongated perpendicular to the outflow with velocity gradient along outflow, tracing infalling flattened envelope

evidence.quote: most likely traces the infalling flattened envelope.

claims.hypothesis: Ions and neutrals show different infall velocities at 100 au due to ambipolar drift
claims.experiment: Kinematical model chi2 fit of H13CO+ and C18O PV diagrams
claims.finding: No detectable drift; field well coupled at 100 au

evidence.quote: the velocity drift between the ionized and neutral gas is at most 0.3 km s$^{-1}$ at a radius of 100 au in B335.

claims.hypothesis: Enhanced ambipolar diffusivity simulations (no small grains) apply to B335
claims.experiment: Compare drift limit with simulated 0.5–1 km/s
claims.finding: Inconsistent with such simulations, though midplane drift not excluded due to resolution

evidence.quote: is not detected in our observations. However, because of our limited angular resolution, we cannot rule out a significant ambipolar drift only in the midplane

why_this_data.value: C18O and H13CO+ chemically similar, abundant in inner envelope, likely optically thin

evidence.quote: C$^{18}$O and H$^{13}$CO$^+$ are chemically similar (cite: Lee04; Aikawa08)

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Ideal MHD case judged less likely because outflow/jets suggest a small disk

evidence.quote: Thus, B335 is less likely the ideal MHD case.

limitations_admitted.value: Limited angular resolution may dilute midplane drift; H13CO+ cannot resolve velocity gradient seen in C18O

evidence.quote: the angular resolution of our H$^{13}$CO$^+$ observations is not sufficient to resolve the velocity gradient observed in the C$^{18}$O emission.

referee_caveats_inferred: Result depends on assumed B>100 uG and ISM C18O abundance for the Hall parameter
Fixed model geometry and temperature and a single power-law velocity profile may bias Vin
Upper limit relies on error propagation of ±0.2 km/s uncertainties

reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Model code and imaging details not provided, so the fit is hard to redo exactly.
